invoices.list.title: List Invoices (sync)
invoices.list.description: Sync QuickBooks Online invoices via authenticated GET /v3/company/{realmId}/query with SELECT * FROM Invoice ORDERBY MetaData.LastUpdatedTime STARTPOSITION n MAXRESULTS m and minorversion=75. Pages until a short page or maxPages, then returns nextCursor (null when done). Pass since (MetaData.LastUpdatedTime >=) for incremental runs; highWatermark is the latest MetaData.LastUpdatedTime seen.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback; numeric.

pageSize.description: MAXRESULTS per query page (QBO max 1000). Default 100.

maxPages.description: Most query pages fetched in this call before returning nextCursor. Default 10.

since.description: Incremental lower bound on MetaData.LastUpdatedTime (ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Use the previous run's highWatermark.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous page of this sync; carries the position and since filter. Takes precedence over since.

hasMore.description: True when more pages remain; call again with nextCursor.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when the sync is done.

highWatermark.description: Greatest MetaData.LastUpdatedTime seen so far in this run; pass as since next run.

startIndex.description: STARTPOSITION of the first page fetched in this call.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the QuickBooks Online connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.

source.description: "provider" only after an authenticated QuickBooks call succeeded; "connector" on the no-credential setup path.

charges.capture.title: Capture Charge
charges.capture.description: Tool to capture funds for an existing charge that was authorized but not captured. Use when you need to complete a previously authorized payment transaction in QuickBooks Payments API. This action finalizes the charge and transfers the funds from the customer's payment method. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CAPTURE_CHARGE. Calls Intuit Payments HTTP API.

amount.description: The amount to capture. If not provided, captures the full authorized amount. For partial captures, specify the amount as a decimal string (e.g., '10.55', '25.00'). The amount must not exceed the authorized amount.

context.description: Additional context information for the capture. This is an optional field that can contain merchant-specific metadata or transaction context.

charge_id.description: The ID of the charge to capture. This is the unique identifier for the authorized charge in QuickBooks Payments (e.g., 'EMU123456789', 'ECH123456789'). Use this to capture funds from a charge that was previously authorized but not captured.

accounts.create.title: Create Account
accounts.create.description: Create a new account in QuickBooks with the given parameters. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_ACCOUNT. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

name.description: User recognizable name for the Account. Account.Name attribute must not contain double quotes (") or colon (:).

active.description: Whether or not the account is active. Inactive accounts may be hidden from display and cannot be posted to. Default is true if not specified.

description.description: User-entered description for the account. May include information to guide bookkeepers in deciding what to post to the account. Maximum length is 100 characters for QuickBooks Online, 200 characters for QuickBooks Desktop.

sub_account.description: Specifies whether this is a subaccount. Set to true to create a subaccount. Must also provide parent_ref when true.

account_type.description: Type of the account to be created. Required field. Valid values: 'Bank', 'Other Current Asset', 'Fixed Asset', 'Other Asset', 'Accounts Receivable', 'Equity', 'Expense', 'Other Expense', 'Cost of Goods Sold', 'Accounts Payable', 'Credit Card', 'Long Term Liability', 'Other Current Liability', 'Income', 'Other Income'.

account_number.description: User-defined account number to help the user in identifying the account within the chart-of-accounts and in deciding what should be posted to the account. must not contain colon (:). For France locales:

opening_balance.description: Opening balance amount when creating a new Balance Sheet account. Used only at account creation for accounts like Bank, Credit Card, etc.

account_sub_type.description: Sub-type of the account. Must use exact enum values (no spaces/slashes). Examples: 'AdvertisingPromotional' (NOT 'Advertising/Promotional'), 'Checking', 'Inventory', 'OtherCurrentAssets', 'Vehicles', 'RetainedEarnings', 'Insurance', 'InterestEarned'. See QuickBooks API docs for complete list.

opening_balance_date.description: Date of the opening balance. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Required if opening_balance is provided.

bank_accounts.create.title: Create Bank Account
bank_accounts.create.description: Create a new bank account on file for a customer in QuickBooks Payments API. Use this when you need to add ACH/eCheck payment capabilities for a customer. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_BANK_ACCOUNT. Calls Intuit Payments HTTP API.

name.description: Account holder name (full name of the person or business).

phone.description: Phone number associated with the bank account holder.

customer_id.description: The customer ID for whom to create the bank account.

account_type.description: Type of bank account. Must be one of: PERSONAL_CHECKING, PERSONAL_SAVINGS, BUSINESS_CHECKING, or BUSINESS_SAVINGS.

routing_number.description: Bank routing number (must be valid and pass checksum validation). Use a valid 9-digit ABA routing number.

bills.create.title: Create Bill
bills.create.description: Create a new bill in QuickBooks Online. A Bill is an AP transaction representing a request-for-payment from a third party for goods or services. Use this action when recording vendor bills for purchases, expenses, or services received. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_BILL. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

Line.description: List of line items for the bill. At least one line item is required. Each line must specify DetailType, Amount, and the appropriate detail object.

DueDate.description: Date when payment for the bill is due in YYYY-MM-DD format.

TxnDate.description: Date of the transaction in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the current date if not provided.

DocNumber.description: Reference number for the bill (e.g., vendor invoice number).

VendorRef.description: Reference to the vendor from whom the bill is received. Required field.

PrivateNote.description: User-entered private note about the bill.

APAccountRef.description: Reference to the Accounts Payable account. Format: {'value': 'account_id'}. If not specified, uses the default AP account.

ExchangeRate.description: Currency exchange rate for multi-currency transactions.

SalesTermRef.description: Reference to the payment terms. Format: {'value': 'term_id'}. Defines when payment is due.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default version.

GlobalTaxCalculation.description: Method in which tax is applied. Valid values: TaxExcluded, TaxInclusive, NotApplicable.

bill_payments.create.title: Create Bill Payment
bill_payments.create.description: Create a bill payment in QuickBooks to record payment against one or more bills. Use when paying vendor bills via check or credit card. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_BILL_PAYMENT. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

Line.description: List of line items indicating which bills are being paid and the amounts applied to each.

PayType.description: Payment method type. Must be either 'Check' or 'CreditCard'.

TxnDate.description: Date of the transaction in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to current date if not specified.

TotalAmt.description: Total amount of the bill payment. Must be positive and match the sum of all line amounts.

VendorRef.description: Reference to the vendor receiving the payment.

PrivateNote.description: Private note for internal use, not visible to the vendor. Maximum 4000 characters.

CheckPayment.description: Check payment details for bill payment.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default from headers.

DepartmentRef.description: Reference to the department for location/department tracking. Must be a dict with 'value' key.

CreditCardPayment.description: Credit card payment details for bill payment.

classes.create.title: Create Class
classes.create.description: Create a new class in QuickBooks Online. Use when you need to categorize transactions by department, location, or other business segments. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_CLASS. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

name.description: The name of the class. Must be unique and cannot contain a colon (:).

Active.description: Whether the class is active. Inactive classes are hidden from most display areas. Default is true.

SubClass.description: Whether this is a subclass. If true, ParentRef must be provided.

credit_memos.create.title: Create Credit Memo
credit_memos.create.description: Tool to create a new credit memo in QuickBooks Online. Use when issuing credit to a customer for returns, refunds, or adjustments. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_CREDIT_MEMO. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

line.description: Array of line items for the credit memo. At least one line item is required.

txn_date.description: Transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to current date if not provided.

class_ref.description: Reference to the class for categorization. Format: {'value': 'class_id'}.

bill_email.description: Email address to send the credit memo to. Must be a valid email format.

doc_number.description: Reference number for the credit memo (maximum 21 characters).

custom_field.description: Array of custom fields for the credit memo.

customer_ref.description: Reference to the customer receiving the credit memo. Required field.

email_status.description: Email status of the credit memo. Valid values: 'NotSet', 'NeedToSend', 'EmailSent'.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default version from headers.

print_status.description: Print status of the credit memo. Valid values: 'NotSet', 'NeedToPrint', 'PrintComplete'.

private_note.description: Private note about the credit memo, not visible to the customer.

customer_memo.description: Message to the customer that appears on the credit memo. Maximum 1000 characters.

department_ref.description: Reference to the department associated with the credit memo. Format: {'value': 'department_id'}.

sales_term_ref.description: Reference to the sales term. Format: {'value': 'term_id'}.

ship_method_ref.description: Reference to the shipping method. Format: {'value': 'ship_method_id'}.

global_tax_calculation.description: Method in which tax is applied. Valid values: 'TaxExcluded', 'TaxInclusive', 'NotApplicable'.

apply_tax_after_discount.description: Whether to apply tax after discount. Defaults to false.

customers.create.title: Create Customer
customers.create.description: Create a new customer in QuickBooks with the given parameters. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_CUSTOMER. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

Job.description: Whether this customer record represents a job. Default is false.

Notes.description: Free-form notes or comments about the customer.

title.description: Title of the person (max 16 characters - keep it short like 'Mr.', 'Dr.', 'CEO'). This tag supports i18n, all locales. The DisplayName attribute or at least one of Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, Suffix, or FullyQualifiedName attributes are required during create.

Active.description: Whether the customer is currently active. Default is true.

Mobile.description: Mobile phone number of the customer.

suffix.description: Suffix of the name. For example, Jr. The DisplayName attribute or at least one of Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, or Suffix attributes is required for object create.

Balance.description: Opening balance amount for this customer at the OpenBalanceDate.

Taxable.description: Whether the customer is taxable. Default is true.

ParentRef.description: Reference to the immediate parent customer for sub-customers.

ResaleNum.description: Resale number or tax-exempt number for the customer.

given_name.description: Given name or first name of a person. The DisplayName attribute or at least one of Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, or Suffix attributes is required for object create.

CompanyName.description: Company name associated with the customer.

CurrencyRef.description: Reference to the currency used for transactions with this customer (e.g., {'value': 'USD'}).

family_name.description: Family name or the last name of the person. The DisplayName attribute or at least one of Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, or Suffix attributes is required for object create.

middle_name.description: Middle name of the person. The person can have zero or more middle names. The DisplayName attribute or at least one of Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, or Suffix attributes is required for object create.

PrimaryPhone.description: Primary phone number of the customer.

display_name.description: The name as displayed. Must be unique across all Customer, Vendor, and Employee objects. Cannot be removed with sparse update. If not supplied, the system generates DisplayName by concatenating customer name components supplied in the request from the following list: Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, and Suffix.

AlternatePhone.description: Alternate phone number of the customer.

BillWithParent.description: Whether this sub-customer should be billed with its parent customer. Default is false.

OpenBalanceDate.description: Date of the opening balance for the customer in YYYY-MM-DD format.

PrimaryEmailAddr.description: Primary email address of the customer.

PrintOnCheckName.description: Name to be printed on checks issued to this customer. If not provided, DisplayName is used.

PreferredDeliveryMethod.description: Preferred delivery method for invoices and communications.

deposits.create.title: Create Deposit
deposits.create.description: Creates a new deposit in QuickBooks Online. A deposit represents funds received and deposited to an asset account (typically a bank account). Use this action to record deposits of customer payments, refunds, or other funds into your bank accounts. Each deposit must specify the destination account and at least one line item showing the source and amount of funds. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_DEPOSIT. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

line.description: List of deposit line items. Each line item represents funds being deposited. At least one line is required. Each line must include: (1) 'Amount' as a positive number, (2) 'DetailType' set to 'DepositLineDetail', (3) 'DepositLineDetail' with 'AccountRef' containing the source account ID. Example: [{'Amount': 100.00, 'DetailType': 'DepositLineDetail', 'DepositLineDetail': {'AccountRef': {'value': '87'}}}]

txn_date.description: Transaction date for the deposit in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2026-02-23'). If not provided, the current date will be used.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number to use for this request (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default API version.

private_note.description: Private note about the deposit (internal use only).

exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate for multi-currency transactions. Default is 1 for home currency.

deposit_to_account_ref.description: Reference to the asset account (bank account) where the deposit will be made. Must be a valid bank account ID. Example: {'value': '35'} for account ID 35. Use QUICKBOOKS_QUERY_ACCOUNT or QUICKBOOKS_READ_ACCOUNT to get valid account IDs.

echeck_payments.create.title: Create eCheck Payment
echeck_payments.create.description: Tool to create an eCheck payment using ACH bank transfer in QuickBooks Payments API. Use when processing payments from customer bank accounts via electronic check. The payment is debited directly from the customer's bank account using the provided routing and account numbers. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_ECHECK_PAYMENT. Calls Intuit Payments HTTP API.

amount.description: Payment amount as a string (e.g., '10.55', '100.00'). Must be a positive number with up to 2 decimal places.

currency.description: Currency code for the payment (e.g., 'USD'). Currently only USD is supported by QuickBooks Payments.

bankAccount.description: Bank account details from which the eCheck payment will be debited. Includes account number, routing number, account type, name, and phone.

employees.create.title: Create Employee
employees.create.description: Create a new employee in QuickBooks. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_EMPLOYEE. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

ssn.description: Social Security Number. Maximum 15 characters for QuickBooks Online, 1024 characters for QuickBooks Desktop.

title.description: Title or honorific of the employee.

active.description: Indicates whether the entity is enabled. Default is true. Employees are deactivated (active=false) rather than deleted.

mobile.description: Mobile phone number of the employee.

suffix.description: Name suffix of the employee. QuickBooks Online only. Maximum 15 characters.

web_addr.description: Website address or URI associated with the employee.

bill_rate.description: Hourly billing rate for the employee. QuickBooks Online only.

cost_rate.description: Cost rate associated with the employee.

birth_date.description: Birth date of the employee, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

given_name.description: Given name (first name) of the employee. Required field. Maximum 100 characters.

hired_date.description: Date the employee was hired, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

other_addr.description: Other physical address(es) of the employee.

family_name.description: Family name (last name) of the employee. Required field. Maximum 100 characters.

middle_name.description: Middle name(s) of the employee. Maximum 5-15 characters depending on product.

company_name.description: Company name associated with the employee.

custom_field.description: Array of custom fields associated with the employee.

display_name.description: Display name of the employee. Must be unique across all customer, employee, and vendor objects. Populated from FullName if not provided. Must not contain colon, tab, or newline characters.

primary_addr.description: Physical street address for this employee. If QuickBooks Payroll is enabled for the company, the following address fields are required: city, country_sub_division_code, and postal_code.

billable_time.description: Indicates whether employee time is billable. QuickBooks Online only.

primary_phone.description: Primary phone number of the employee.

released_date.description: Date the employee left the company, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

use_time_entry.description: Indicates whether time sheets create paychecks for this employee.

alternate_phone.description: Alternate phone number of the employee.

employee_number.description: Employee directory number. Maximum 15 for QuickBooks Online, 99 for QuickBooks Desktop.

other_contact_info.description: List of additional contact information entities.

primary_email_addr.description: Primary email address of the employee.

print_on_check_name.description: Name as it should appear on printed checks.

default_tax_code_ref.description: Reference to the default tax code associated with the employee.

estimates.create.title: Create Estimate
estimates.create.description: Creates a new estimate in QuickBooks Online. An estimate represents a proposal for goods or services that a customer may purchase. Use this to provide pricing quotes to customers before they commit to a purchase. This action requires a valid customer ID and at least one line item with item details and amount. The created estimate can later be converted to an invoice when the customer accepts the proposal. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_ESTIMATE. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

lines.description: List of estimate line items. Each line item must include DetailType, Amount, and appropriate detail object (e.g., SalesItemLineDetail for item-based lines).

txn_date.description: Date of the estimate transaction in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-01-15'). If not specified, the current date is used.

class_ref.description: Reference to a class for categorization.

ship_date.description: Date for delivery of goods or services in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-03-15').

bill_email.description: Email address where the estimate should be sent.

doc_number.description: Reference number for the estimate. If not specified, QuickBooks generates one automatically.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer for whom the estimate is created. This is the unique identifier for the customer in QuickBooks (e.g., '1', '3'). Use QUICKBOOKS_READ_CUSTOMER or QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_CUSTOMER to get valid customer IDs.

custom_field.description: Custom fields for the estimate. QuickBooks Online supports up to 3 custom fields. The custom fields must already exist in QuickBooks.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number to use for this request (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default API version from headers.

private_note.description: User-entered private note about the estimate, not visible to the customer. Maximum 4000 characters.

tracking_num.description: Shipping provider's tracking number for the delivery of goods. Maximum 31 characters.

customer_memo.description: Message to the customer that appears on the estimate.

exchange_rate.description: The exchange rate for the transaction. Applicable if multi-currency is enabled. Defaults to 1.

expiration_date.description: Date by which the estimate must be accepted in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-02-28').

global_tax_calculation.description: Method in which tax is applied. Valid values: TaxExcluded, TaxInclusive, NotApplicable. Default is TaxExcluded.

apply_tax_after_discount.description: If true, tax is applied after discount. If false or null, calculate sales tax first then apply discount. US QuickBooks companies only. Defaults to false.

invoices.create.title: Create Invoice
invoices.create.description: Creates a new invoice in QuickBooks for a customer. An invoice represents a sales transaction where goods or services are sold to a customer on credit or for immediate payment. This action requires: - A valid customer ID (obtain from QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_CUSTOMER or QUICKBOOKS_READ_CUSTOMER) - At least one line item with a valid item/service ID and amount The created invoice will have a unique ID, document number, due date, total amount, and balance. Use this to bill customers for products or services rendered. To update the invoice later, re-read it first to obtain the current SyncToken; stale tokens cause update rejections. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_INVOICE. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

fob.description: Free On Board (FOB) designation for shipping terms. Defines when ownership and liability transfer from seller to buyer.

lines.description: List of invoice line items. Each line item must be a dictionary with: (1) 'DetailType' set to 'SalesItemLineDetail', (2) 'Amount' as a number representing the line total, (3) 'SalesItemLineDetail' as a dictionary containing 'ItemRef' with a 'value' key for the item ID (e.g., {'ItemRef': {'value': '1'}}). Optional fields include 'Description' (text), 'Qty' (quantity as number), and 'UnitPrice' (price per unit as number). Example: [{'DetailType': 'SalesItemLineDetail', 'Amount': 100.00, 'SalesItemLineDetail': {'ItemRef': {'value': '1'}, 'Qty': 2, 'UnitPrice': 50.00}}]

due_date.description: Date when payment for the invoice is due in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2026-03-25'). Calculated from TxnDate and SalesTermRef if not explicitly provided.

txn_date.description: Date when the transaction occurred in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2026-02-25'). This is the posting date that affects financial statements. If not supplied, the current server date is used.

bill_addr.description: Bill-to address of the invoice. Provide as a dictionary with keys like 'Line1', 'City', 'CountrySubDivisionCode', 'PostalCode'. If not provided, defaults to the customer's billing address.

class_ref.description: Reference to the class associated with the transaction for categorization and reporting. Provide as a dictionary with 'value' key for the class ID (e.g., {'value': '5'}).

po_number.description: Purchase order number provided by the customer. Maximum 25 characters (QuickBooks Windows) or 15 characters (QuickBooks Online).

requestid.description: Optional idempotency key (maximum 50 characters) to prevent duplicate writes on retries. If provided, QuickBooks will not create a duplicate invoice if the same requestid is used again.

ship_addr.description: Shipping address for the invoice. Provide as a dictionary with keys like 'Line1', 'City', 'CountrySubDivisionCode', 'PostalCode'. If not provided, defaults to the customer's shipping address.

ship_date.description: Date when the product was shipped or service was performed in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2026-02-25').

bill_email.description: Email address where the invoice should be sent. Provide as a dictionary with 'Address' key (e.g., {'Address': 'customer@example.com'}).

doc_number.description: Reference number for the transaction. Maximum 21 characters for QuickBooks Online. If not provided, QuickBooks auto-generates this by incrementing the last number.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer to invoice. This is the unique identifier for the customer in QuickBooks (e.g., '1', '92'). Use QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_CUSTOMER or QUICKBOOKS_READ_CUSTOMER to get valid customer IDs. Customer must be active; inactive customer IDs will cause invoice creation to fail. Similarly, all ItemRef values in `lines` must reference active items/services.

project_ref.description: Reference to the project associated with the invoice. Provide as a dictionary with 'value' key for the project ID (e.g., {'value': '10'}).

currency_ref.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts on the invoice are expressed. Provide as a dictionary with 'value' key for the currency code (e.g., {'value': 'USD'}).

custom_field.description: Array of custom fields for the invoice. QuickBooks Online supports up to 3 custom fields. Each field should be a dictionary with 'DefinitionId', 'Name', 'Type', and value keys (e.g., [{'DefinitionId': '1', 'Name': 'Field1', 'Type': 'StringType', 'StringValue': 'Value1'}]).

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number to use for this request (e.g., 65, 70, 75). Allows access to version-specific features. If not specified, uses the default API version.

private_note.description: User-entered, organization-private note about the transaction that will not appear on customer-facing records. Maximum 4000 characters.

template_ref.description: Reference to the template used for formatting the invoice. Provide as a dictionary with 'value' key for the template ID (e.g., {'value': '5'}).

tracking_num.description: Shipping provider's tracking number for the delivery. Maximum 31 characters.

bill_email_cc.description: CC email address for the invoice. Provide as a dictionary with 'Address' key (e.g., {'Address': 'cc@example.com'}).

customer_memo.description: User-entered message to the customer that appears on the invoice. Provide as a dictionary with 'value' key (e.g., {'value': 'Thank you for your business'}). Maximum 1000 characters.

exchange_rate.description: Currency exchange rate for multi-currency environments. Exchange rates are always recorded as the number of home currency units per one foreign currency unit.

bill_email_bcc.description: BCC email address for the invoice. Provide as a dictionary with 'Address' key (e.g., {'Address': 'bcc@example.com'}).

department_ref.description: Reference to the department for location tracking (QuickBooks Online). Provide as a dictionary with 'value' key for the department ID (e.g., {'value': '1'}).

sales_term_ref.description: Reference to the sales terms (payment terms) that determine the invoice due date. Provide as a dictionary with 'value' key for the term ID (e.g., {'value': '3'}).

ship_from_addr.description: Ship-from address for the invoice. Provide as a dictionary with keys like 'Line1', 'City', 'CountrySubDivisionCode', 'PostalCode'.

txn_tax_detail.description: Details of taxes charged on the transaction as a whole. Provide as a dictionary with 'TxnTaxCodeRef' and/or 'TaxLine' keys. QuickBooks automatically calculates this based on tax codes if not provided.

ship_method_ref.description: Reference to the shipping method. Provide as a dictionary with 'value' key for the shipping method ID (e.g., {'value': '2'}).

allow_ipn_payment.description: Specifies whether customer is allowed to use IPN (Instant Payment Notification) to pay the invoice.

allow_online_payment.description: Specifies whether customer is allowed to use eInvoicing (online payment) to pay the invoice.

deposit_to_account_ref.description: Reference to the asset account where payment deposits are recorded. Provide as a dictionary with 'value' key for the account ID (e.g., {'value': '35'}).

global_tax_calculation.description: Method used to apply taxes. Valid values: 'TaxExcluded', 'TaxInclusive', 'NotApplicable'. Default is 'TaxExcluded'.

allow_online_ach_payment.description: Permits customers to pay via electronic bank transfers (ACH) through eInvoicing.

apply_tax_after_discount.description: If false or null, calculate sales tax first then apply discount. If true, apply discount first then calculate tax. US QuickBooks companies only.

allow_online_credit_card_payment.description: Permits customers to pay via credit cards through eInvoicing.

items.create.title: Create Item
items.create.description: Create a new item in QuickBooks Online. Items represent the products or services that a company buys, sells, or resells. Use when adding new inventory items, services, or non-inventory products to the QuickBooks catalog. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_ITEM. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

name.description: User-recognizable name for the item. This is the name displayed in lists and forms in QuickBooks.

type.description: Classification specifying the use of this item. Valid values: 'Service' (services offered for sale), 'Inventory' (products bought and sold with quantity tracking - requires QuickBooks Online Plus or Advanced), 'NonInventory' (products bought and sold without quantity tracking), 'Category' (used to group items together), 'Bundle' (combination of products/services sold together). Different types have different required fields.

active.description: Whether the item is active and available for use. Default is true.

taxable.description: Whether sales of this item are subject to sales tax. Default is false.

unit_price.description: Unit price of the item for sales. This is the default selling price per unit.

description.description: Description of the item that appears on sales forms such as invoices. This helps customers understand what they are purchasing.

qty_on_hand.description: Current quantity on hand for this inventory item. REQUIRED if TrackQtyOnHand is true. Must be a non-negative number.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number to use for this request (e.g., 65, 70, 75). Allows access to version-specific features. If not specified, uses the default API version.

purchase_cost.description: Cost to purchase this item from vendors. This is the default purchase cost per unit.

purchase_desc.description: Description of the item for purchase forms. This is the description used when purchasing the item from vendors.

inv_start_date.description: Date when inventory tracking begins for this item. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. REQUIRED if TrackQtyOnHand is true.

track_qty_on_hand.description: Whether quantity on hand is tracked for this item. If true, you must provide QtyOnHand and InvStartDate. Applicable for Inventory items.

journal_entries.create.title: Create Journal Entry
journal_entries.create.description: Tool to create a new journal entry in QuickBooks Online. Use when you need to make adjusting or correcting entries that directly affect account balances. Journal entries require at least two lines with total debits equaling total credits. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_JOURNAL_ENTRY. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

Line.description: List of journal entry lines. Each journal entry must have at least two lines, and the total debits must equal the total credits. Typically includes at least one debit line and one credit line with matching amounts.

TxnDate.description: Transaction date for the journal entry in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, the current date is used.

DocNumber.description: Reference number for the journal entry. Maximum 21 characters.

Adjustment.description: Indicates if this is an adjustment journal entry. Set to true for adjusting entries.

PrivateNote.description: Private note about the journal entry. Maximum 4000 characters.

ExchangeRate.description: Exchange rate for multi-currency journal entries.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number to use for this request (e.g., 65, 70, 75). Allows access to version-specific features. If not specified, uses the default API version.

payments.create.title: Create Payment
payments.create.description: Creates a payment record in QuickBooks Online. The Payment entity records payment from customers against single or multiple invoices and credit memos. Use this action when recording customer payments, whether full payment of an invoice or partial payment across multiple invoices. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_PAYMENT. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

lines.description: List of payment line items specifying which invoices or credit memos the payment is applied to. Each line item must contain Amount and LinkedTxn fields. Example: [{'Amount': 50.0, 'LinkedTxn': [{'TxnId': '11', 'TxnType': 'Invoice'}]}]

txn_date.description: Date of the payment transaction in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-01-15'). If not specified, the current date is used.

total_amt.description: Total amount of the payment. This should equal the sum of all Line item amounts. Must be a positive number (e.g., 50.0, 100.0).

customer_id.description: ID of the customer making the payment. This is the unique identifier for the customer in QuickBooks (e.g., '3', '58'). Use QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_CUSTOMER or QUICKBOOKS_READ_CUSTOMER to get valid customer IDs.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number to use for this request (e.g., 65, 70, 75). Allows access to version-specific features. If not specified, uses the default API version.

private_note.description: Private note about the payment. Not visible to the customer. Maximum 4000 characters.

customer_name.description: Name of the customer. Optional field that helps with readability but not required by the API.

exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate for the transaction when using multi-currency. Applicable only if multi-currency is enabled. Optional field.

payment_ref_num.description: Reference number for the payment, such as a check number or transaction ID. Optional field.

process_payment.description: Indicates whether the payment should be processed through QuickBooks Payments. Set to true to process the payment, false otherwise. Optional field.

ar_account_ref_id.description: ID of the accounts receivable account. Optional field. Use QuickBooks query API to get valid AR account IDs.

currency_ref_value.description: Currency code for multi-currency environments (e.g., 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR'). Required if the company file uses multi-currency. Optional otherwise.

credit_card_payment.description: Credit card payment details when payment method is credit card.

payment_method_ref_id.description: ID of the payment method used (e.g., '1' for Cash, '2' for Check). Optional field. Use QuickBooks query API to get valid payment method IDs.

deposit_to_account_ref_id.description: ID of the asset account where this payment should be deposited. Optional field. If not provided, uses the default Undeposited Funds account.

purchases.create.title: Create Purchase
purchases.create.description: Tool to create a new purchase transaction in QuickBooks Online. A purchase represents an expense such as a cash payment, check, or credit card purchase. Use when recording business expenses or making payments to vendors. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_PURCHASE. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

Line.description: List of line items for the purchase. At least one line item is required. Each line must have an Amount and DetailType with corresponding detail object.

TxnDate.description: Date of the transaction in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2024-08-23'). If not provided, uses the current date.

TotalAmt.description: Total amount of the purchase including all line items. If not provided, QuickBooks will calculate it from the line items. Should match the sum of all line amounts.

DocNumber.description: Reference number for the purchase (e.g., check number). Maximum 21 characters.

EntityRef.description: Reference to an entity (vendor, customer, employee).

AccountRef.description: Reference to the account from which the payment is made (e.g., {'value': '19'} for a checking account or {'value': '42'} for a credit card account).

PaymentType.description: Payment method used for this purchase. Choose 'Cash', 'Check', or 'CreditCard'.

PrivateNote.description: Private note about the purchase, visible only to company users. Maximum 4000 characters.

ExchangeRate.description: Exchange rate for multi-currency transactions. Required if CurrencyRef is different from home currency.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number to use for this request (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default API version from headers.

PaymentMethodRef.description: Reference to an entity (vendor, customer, employee).

GlobalTaxCalculation.description: Method used to apply tax on the transaction. Valid values: 'TaxExcluded', 'TaxInclusive', 'NotApplicable'.

TransactionLocationType.description: The location type of the transaction. Used for international tax calculations.

purchase_orders.create.title: Create Purchase Order
purchase_orders.create.description: Create a new purchase order in QuickBooks. Use when you need to send a request to a vendor to deliver goods or services. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_PURCHASE_ORDER. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

fob.description: Free On Board shipping terms indicating point of transfer of ownership.

memo.description: Memo or note about the purchase order visible on reports and to the vendor.

lines.description: List of line items for the purchase order. Each line must have an 'amount' (number), 'detail_type' ('ItemBasedExpenseLineDetail' or 'AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail'), and corresponding detail object. For item-based lines, include 'item_based_expense_line_detail' with an 'item_ref'. For account-based lines, include 'account_based_expense_line_detail' with an 'account_ref'.

due_date.description: Date when payment for the purchase order is due in YYYY-MM-DD format.

txn_date.description: Transaction date of the purchase order in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the current date if not provided.

total_amt.description: Total amount of the purchase order. Should equal the sum of all line amounts.

vendor_id.description: ID of the vendor for this purchase order. Use QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_VENDOR or QUICKBOOKS_READ_VENDOR to get valid vendor IDs.

doc_number.description: Reference number for the purchase order. If not provided, QuickBooks will auto-generate it.

custom_field.description: Custom fields for the purchase order.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default API version.

private_note.description: Private note about the purchase order, not visible to the vendor.

ap_account_id.description: ID of the Accounts Payable account to use for this purchase order. This is typically the main AP account in your chart of accounts.

exchange_rate.description: Currency exchange rate for multi-currency transactions.

expected_date.description: Expected delivery date for products in YYYY-MM-DD format.

txn_tax_detail.description: Transaction tax detail information including TxnTaxCodeRef and TaxLine.

global_tax_calculation.description: Method in which tax is applied. Valid values: 'TaxExcluded', 'TaxInclusive', 'NotApplicable'.

refund_receipts.create.title: Create Refund Receipt
refund_receipts.create.description: Tool to create a new refund receipt in QuickBooks Online. Use when a customer receives a refund for returned goods or services. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_REFUND_RECEIPT. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

Line.description: List of line items for the refund receipt. At least one line item is required. Each line must specify Amount, DetailType, and relevant detail information.

TxnDate.description: Transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, the current date is used.

DocNumber.description: Reference number for the refund receipt. Maximum 21 characters.

CustomField.description: List of custom fields for the refund receipt.

CustomerRef.description: Reference to the customer receiving the refund. Required.

PrivateNote.description: Internal note about the refund receipt, not visible to customer.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default API version.

PaymentRefNum.description: Reference number for the payment (e.g., check number, transaction ID).

DepositToAccountRef.description: Reference to the asset account where the refund is deposited. Required for the refund receipt.

sales_receipts.create.title: Create Sales Receipt
sales_receipts.create.description: Tool to create a new sales receipt in QuickBooks Online. Use when recording a sale where the customer pays immediately (cash, check, credit card). Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_SALES_RECEIPT. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

line.description: Array of line items for the sales receipt. At least one line item is required.

txn_date.description: Transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to current date if not provided.

class_ref.description: Generic reference type for various entities.

ship_date.description: Date when goods or services are scheduled for delivery in YYYY-MM-DD format.

doc_number.description: Reference number for the sales receipt (maximum 21 characters).

custom_field.description: Array of custom fields for the sales receipt.

customer_ref.description: Reference to the customer receiving the sales receipt. Required field.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default API version.

private_note.description: Private note about the sales receipt, not visible to the customer.

tracking_num.description: Shipping tracking number provided by the shipping provider.

customer_memo.description: Customer memo for the sales receipt.

department_ref.description: Generic reference type for various entities.

sales_term_ref.description: Generic reference type for various entities.

payment_ref_num.description: Reference number for the payment (e.g., check number, transaction ID).

ship_method_ref.description: Generic reference type for various entities.

payment_method_ref.description: Reference to the payment method (e.g., {'value': '1'}). Use to specify how the customer paid.

global_tax_calculation.description: Method in which tax is applied. Allowed values: TaxExcluded, TaxInclusive, NotApplicable.

apply_tax_after_discount.description: Whether to apply tax after discount. Defaults to false.

tax_agencies.create.title: Create Tax Agency
tax_agencies.create.description: Create a new tax agency in QuickBooks Online. Use when you need to set up a new tax authority or agency for tax reporting purposes. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_TAX_AGENCY. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

DisplayName.description: The name of the tax agency as displayed in QuickBooks. Must be unique.

taxservice_taxcode.create.title: Create Tax Code via TaxService
taxservice_taxcode.create.description: Create a new tax code with associated tax rates using the TaxService endpoint. Use when you need to set up new tax codes for sales or purchase transactions with specific tax rates. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_TAXSERVICE_TAXCODE. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

TaxCode.description: The unique identifier for the tax code being created. Must be unique within the QuickBooks company.

TaxRateDetails.description: List of tax rate details to associate with this tax code. At least one tax rate detail is required.

time_activities.create.title: Create Time Activity
time_activities.create.description: Create a new time activity record in QuickBooks Online. TimeActivity tracks employee or vendor time worked on jobs or projects. Use when recording billable or non-billable hours for employees or vendors. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_TIME_ACTIVITY. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

hours.description: Number of hours worked. Alternative to using start_time and end_time. Use with minutes field to specify duration.

minutes.description: Number of minutes worked (0-59). Use with hours field to specify duration as an alternative to start_time and end_time.

name_of.description: Specifies the type of entity: 'Employee' for employee time tracking, or 'Vendor' for vendor/contractor time tracking.

taxable.description: Whether the time activity is taxable. Set to true if subject to sales tax.

end_time.description: End time of the time activity in ISO 8601 format with timezone (e.g., '2026-02-23T17:00:00+00:00'). Required unless using hours and minutes fields.

txn_date.description: Transaction date for the time activity in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2026-02-23'). If not provided, current date is used.

start_time.description: Start time of the time activity in ISO 8601 format with timezone (e.g., '2026-02-23T09:00:00+00:00'). Required unless using hours and minutes fields.

break_hours.description: Number of break hours to subtract from the time activity duration.

description.description: Description of work completed during this time activity.

hourly_rate.description: Hourly billing rate for this time activity. If not provided, uses the default rate from the employee/vendor record.

break_minutes.description: Number of break minutes (0-59) to subtract from the time activity duration.

billable_status.description: Billable status of the time activity.

vendors.create.title: Create Vendor
vendors.create.description: Create a new vendor in QuickBooks with the given details. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_VENDOR. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

fax.description: Phone number input for vendor creation.

gstin.description: GST Identification Number (applicable for Indian vendors).

notes.description: Additional notes or comments about the vendor.

title.description: Title of the person (max 16 characters - keep it short like 'Mr.', 'Dr.', 'CEO'). This tag supports i18n, all locales. The DisplayName attribute or at least one of Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, Suffix, or FullyQualifiedName attributes are required during create.

active.description: Indicates whether the vendor is currently active. Set to False to make inactive.

mobile.description: Phone number input for vendor creation.

suffix.description: Suffix of the name. For example, Jr. The DisplayName attribute or at least one of Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, or Suffix attributes is required for object create.

balance.description: Opening balance amount for this vendor. Use with open_balance_date.

acct_num.description: Account number assigned to this vendor for tracking purposes.

term_ref.description: Reference type input for entity references.

web_addr.description: Website address input for vendor creation.

bill_addr.description: Physical address input for vendor creation.

bill_rate.description: Standard billing rate for the vendor (per hour or unit).

ship_addr.description: Physical address input for vendor creation.

given_name.description: Given name or first name of a person. The DisplayName attribute or at least one of Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, or Suffix attributes is required for object create.

parent_ref.description: Reference type input for entity references.

family_name.description: Family name or the last name of the person. The DisplayName attribute or at least one of Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, or Suffix attributes is required for object create.

middle_name.description: Middle name of the person. The person can have zero or more middle names. The DisplayName attribute or at least one of Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, or Suffix attributes is required for object create.

tds_enabled.description: Indicates if Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) is enabled (India).

vendor_1099.description: Indicates whether the vendor is eligible for 1099 tax reporting (US tax purposes).

company_name.description: The name of the company associated with the vendor. Useful when creating organizational vendors.

contact_name.description: Primary contact person's name at the vendor.

credit_limit.description: Maximum credit amount extended to the vendor.

currency_ref.description: Reference type input for entity references.

display_name.description: The name as displayed. Must be unique across all Customer, Vendor, and Employee objects. Cannot be removed with sparse update. If not supplied, the system generates DisplayName by concatenating customer name components supplied in the request from the following list: Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, and Suffix.

t4a_eligible.description: Canadian T4A tax form eligibility status.

primary_phone.description: Phone number input for vendor creation.

ap_account_ref.description: Reference type input for entity references.

t5018_eligible.description: Canadian T5018 tax form eligibility status.

tax_identifier.description: Tax identification number for the vendor (EIN or SSN).

alternate_phone.description: Phone number input for vendor creation.

business_number.description: Business registration number or tax identification number.

alt_contact_name.description: Alternate contact person's name at the vendor.

open_balance_date.description: Date of the opening balance in YYYY-MM-DD format.

primary_email_addr.description: Email address input for vendor creation.

print_on_check_name.description: The name of the vendor as it should be printed on checks. If not provided, uses DisplayName.

default_tax_code_ref.description: Reference type input for entity references.

gst_registration_type.description: GST registration type (applicable for Indian vendors, e.g., 'Regular', 'Composition').

tax_id_effective_date.description: Effective date for the tax identification number in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tds_override_threshold.description: Whether to override the standard TDS threshold limits (India).

vendor_credits.create.title: Create Vendor Credit
vendor_credits.create.description: Tool to create a new vendor credit in QuickBooks Online. Use when recording a credit from a vendor that reduces what you owe. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CREATE_VENDOR_CREDIT. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

Line.description: List of line items for the vendor credit. At least one line item is required. Each line must specify DetailType, Amount, and AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail.

Memo.description: Memo for the vendor credit that appears on reports.

TxnDate.description: Date of the transaction in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the current date if not provided.

DocNumber.description: Reference number for the vendor credit (e.g., credit memo number from vendor).

VendorRef.description: Reference to the vendor from whom the credit is received. Required field.

PrivateNote.description: User-entered private note about the vendor credit.

APAccountRef.description: Reference to the Accounts Payable account. Format: {'value': 'account_id'}. If not specified, uses the default AP account.

ExchangeRate.description: Currency exchange rate for multi-currency transactions.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number (e.g., 65, 70, 75). If not specified, uses the default version.

GlobalTaxCalculation.description: Method in which tax is applied. Valid values: TaxExcluded, TaxInclusive, NotApplicable.

customer_balance_detail.get.title: Customer Balance Detail
customer_balance_detail.get.description: Generate a balance detail report for a customer in QuickBooks with the given customer ID. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CUSTOMER_BALANCE_DETAIL. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

columns.description: Column types to be shown in the report. Supported Values: bill_addr, create_by, create_date, cust_bill_email, cust_comp_name, cust_msg, cust_phone_other, cust_tel, cust_name, deliv_addr, doc_num*, due_date*, last_mod_by, last_mod_date, memo*, sale_sent_state, ship_addr, ship_date, ship_via, term_name, tracking_num, tx_date*, txn_type*. Additional columns with custom fields enabled: sales_cust1, sales_cust2, sales_cust3. Additional columns with location tracking enabled: dept_name*

custom1.description: Filter by the specified custom field as defined by the CustomField attribute in transaction entities where supported. Supported Values: Name of custom field.

shipvia.description: Filter by the shipping method as stored in Invoice.ShipMethodRef.Name.

sort_by.description: The column type used in sorting report rows. Specify a column type as defined with the columns query parameter.

term_ids.description: One or more comma separated term IDs. Filters report contents based on term or terms supplied.

end_duedate.description: The range of dates over which receivables are due, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_duedate must be less than end_duedate. If not specified, all data is returned.

report_date.description: Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

aging_method.description: The date upon which aging is determined.

customer_ids.description: One or more comma separated customer IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified customers.

start_duedate.description: The range of dates over which receivables are due, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_duedate must be less than end_duedate. If not specified, all data is returned.

department_ids.description: One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file.

customer_balance_report.get.title: Customer Balance Report
customer_balance_report.get.description: Generate a customer balance report in QuickBooks showing outstanding balances for customers. Can filter by specific customers, date ranges, payment status, and accounting method. Returns a hierarchical report with customer names, IDs, and their current balance amounts. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_CUSTOMER_BALANCE_REPORT. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

qzurl.description: Specifies whether Quick Zoom URL information should be generated for rows in the report.

arpaid.description: Filter by payment status. 'All' includes all balances, 'Paid' shows only paid invoices, 'Unpaid' shows only outstanding balances. If not specified, defaults to showing all.

date_macro.description: Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range.

report_date.description: Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

customer_ids.description: List of customer IDs to filter the report. If not provided, the report includes all customers. Each ID should be the Customer.Id value from the Customer object (e.g., ['1', '2', '10']).

department_ids.description: One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file.

accounting_method.description: The accounting method used in the report.

summarize_column_by.description: The criteria by which to group the report results.

bank_accounts.delete.title: Delete Bank Account
bank_accounts.delete.description: Tool to delete a bank account on file for a customer in QuickBooks Payments API. Use when removing a customer's payment method. Returns 204 No Content on success with an empty response body from the API. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_DELETE_BANK_ACCOUNT. Calls Intuit Payments HTTP API.

request_id.description: UUID for idempotency to prevent duplicate requests. If not provided, one will be generated automatically.

customer_id.description: The customer ID for whom the bank account is being deleted (can be a test ID like 'test-customer-id')

bank_account_id.description: The bank account ID to delete

items.delete.title: Delete Item
items.delete.description: Delete an item in QuickBooks Online by marking it as inactive (soft delete). Items cannot be permanently deleted if they have been used in transactions. Use this action when removing items from active catalogs while preserving historical transaction data. The item will be hidden from dropdowns but remain accessible in historical records. This action is irreversible through the API — the item can only be reactivated manually through the QuickBooks UI or by using an update action. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_DELETE_ITEM. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

item_id.description: Unique identifier of the item to delete. This is the Id field from the item object.

sync_token.description: Version number of the entity for optimistic locking. This is the SyncToken field from the item object. Use QUICKBOOKS_GET_ITEM to retrieve the current SyncToken before deletion.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number to use for this request (e.g., 65, 70, 75). Allows access to version-specific features. If not specified, uses the default API version.

batch.execute.title: Execute Batch Operation
batch.execute.description: Execute multiple QuickBooks operations in a single request. Operations are performed serially. Supports create, update, delete, and query operations on QuickBooks entities. Use this action to reduce network latency when performing multiple operations. Each operation is executed in order, and each response is correlated to its request via the bId field. Maximum 30 operations per batch. Ideal for bulk data operations or related entity updates. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_EXECUTE_BATCH_OPERATION. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

minorversion.description: QuickBooks API minor version number to use for this request (e.g., 65, 70, 75). Allows access to version-specific features. If not specified, uses the default API version from metadata.

Use IN operator instead for matching multiple specific values (e.g., 'WHERE Id IN ("1", "2", "3")' instead of 'WHERE Id = "1" OR Id = "2"'). For pattern matching across multiple terms with LIKE (e.g., finding items containing 'Larkspur' in FullyQualifiedName OR Description), query without the WHERE clause or with a broader filter, then filter results client-side. SyncToken.description: Version token for optimistic locking, obtained from a prior GET request. Prevents concurrent update conflicts.

CurrencyRef.description: Reference to a currency for multi-currency transactions.

PrivateNote.description: Internal note about the transfer that is not visible to customers.

ExchangeRate.description: Exchange rate for multi-currency transactions. Default is 1 for home currency. Only applicable when using non-home currency.

ToAccountRef.description: Reference to the destination account to which funds are transferred.

DepartmentRef.description: Reference to a department for location tracking.

FromAccountRef.description: Reference to the source account from which funds are transferred.

vendor_balance_detail.get.title: Vendor Balance Detail
vendor_balance_detail.get.description: Generate a balance detail report for a vendor in QuickBooks with the given vendor ID. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_VENDOR_BALANCE_DETAIL. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

arpaid.description: Filter by payment status. Use 'All' for all balances, 'Paid' for fully paid balances, or 'Unpaid' for outstanding balances.

columns.description: Column types to be shown in the report. Supported Values: bill_addr, create_by, create_date, vend_bill_email, vend_comp_name, vend_msg, vend_phone_other, vend_tel, vend_name, deliv_addr, doc_num*, due_date*, last_mod_by, last_mod_date, memo*, vendor_sent_state, ship_addr, ship_date, term_name, tracking_num, tx_date*, txn_type*. Additional columns with custom fields enabled: purchase_vend1, purchase_vend2, purchase_vend3. Additional columns with location tracking enabled: dept_name*

sort_by.description: The column type used in sorting report rows. Specify a column type as defined with the columns query parameter.

term_ids.description: One or more comma separated term IDs. Filters report contents based on term or terms supplied.

date_macro.description: Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range.

vendor_ids.description: One or more comma separated vendor IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified vendors.

end_duedate.description: The range of dates over which receivables are due, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_duedate must be less than end_duedate. If not specified, all data is returned.

num_periods.description: Number of aging periods to display in the report. Each period represents a time bucket for aging calculations (e.g., 0-30 days, 31-60 days).

report_date.description: Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

aging_method.description: Method for calculating age of payables. 'Report_Date' calculates age based on the report date, while 'Current' calculates age based on the current date.

aging_period.description: Number of days per aging period. Default is typically 30 days. For example, setting this to 30 creates buckets like 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 days.

duedate_macro.description: Predefined date range of due dates for balances to include in the report; otherwise, use the start_duedate and end_duedate to cover an explicit report date range.

start_duedate.description: The range of dates over which receivables are due, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_duedate must be less than end_duedate. If not specified, all data is returned.

department_ids.description: One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file.

accounting_method.description: The accounting method used in the report.

vendor_balance_report.get.title: Vendor Balance Report
vendor_balance_report.get.description: Retrieve a vendor balance report from QuickBooks showing outstanding balances for vendors. This report displays the total amount owed to each vendor, providing a summary of accounts payable. You can filter by specific vendors, date ranges, payment status, and customize the report with various grouping and sorting options. Composio tool QUICKBOOKS_VENDOR_BALANCE_REPORT. Calls Intuit QuickBooks Online Accounting HTTP API.

realmId.description: QuickBooks company ID (realmId) from the OAuth callback.

qzurl.description: Specifies whether Quick Zoom URL information should be generated for rows in the report.

appaid.description: Filters vendors by payment status. Use 'All' for all vendors, 'Paid' for vendors with fully paid balances, or 'Unpaid' for vendors with outstanding balances.

date_macro.description: Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range.

vendor_ids.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified vendors. Supported Values: One or more comma separated vendor IDs as returned in the attribute, Vendor.Id, of the Vendor object response code.

report_date.description: Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

department_ids.description: One or more comma separated department IDs. Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file.

accounting_method.description: The accounting method used in the report.

summarize_column_by.description: The criteria by which to group the report results.
